scope: Logical reachability only; not gameplay, mass, quantity, geography or economy validation.

checks.name: All defined capabilities have a bootstrap route
No metals: raft, pottery, textiles and farming remain possible
No tin: iron, steel and water power remain possible
No copper: surface iron avoids a copper-pick bootstrap cycle
No power site: advanced hand workshop remains possible
No bamboo: log raft remains possible
No iron: bronze-driven milling remains possible
No bellows: thermal metallurgy stays blocked
Ore alone cannot bypass bloom consolidation
